memory_candidates.content: In this repo, check-extension-docs.sh's manifest.provides.scripts entries can include the doc-lint script itself (e.g. core declares check-extension-docs.sh). Any edit to a deployed .claude/scripts/<name> that is also a provides.scripts entry must be mirrored into that extension's own source (.claude/extensions/<ext>/scripts/<name>), otherwise a newly-added content-diff drift guard will immediately self-flag the edit as drift the moment it is introduced.

check-extension-docs.sh in this repo has pre-existing, long-standing FAIL entries unrelated to any specific task: core reports 3 undeclared-script-reference failures (literature-briefing-invoke.sh, orchestrator-postflight.sh, task-lock.sh referenced in docs but not in provides.scripts) and lean reports 2 routing_hard-target-not-deployed failures (skill-lean-research-hard, skill-lean-implementation-hard). Verified via git stash (task 841) that these exist identically with and without unrelated changes. Do not assume script-wide exit 1 means your own change broke something -- check whether the specific extension section you touched is PASS.
